content:
maya: Quick RFC follow-up: we need to untangle regional/locality logic so small changes don't force router + policy deploys.
devon: Observed issues: region preference logic lives in router, cost/latency heuristics in policy DSL. painful to change.
ron: Telemetry emission is split too. sometimes router emits probes, sometimes policy does. makes attribution hard.
maya: Proposal: extract a tiny LocalityScorer interface (pure function). runtime calls scorer(request_features, telemetry_snapshot, constraints) -> [(route_id, score, hints)]. scorer implementations pluggable via feature-flag.
priya: How do tenant overrides fit? pins/preference for region or dedicated GPUs? post-filter or input param?
devon: Put tenant constraints in input. scorer should only score compatible routes; router enforces admission after scoring. keeps scorer deterministic and testable.
ron: Add a compatibility helper: is_compatible(route_meta, constraints) -> bool. scorer can call it or router can pre-filter.
maya: Minimal interface we want in the spec: score(request_features, telemetry_snapshot, constraints) -> list of tuples and is_compatible(route_meta, constraints) -> bool. Keep it language-agnostic; consider wasm for runtime swapping.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduler: canary run for scorer.v2 tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC.
priya: Rollout notes: feature-flag by tenant id; migrate DSL region_penalty/cost_cap by compiling them to scorer config. Need a translator step.
devon: Translator example (policy-compiler emits a scorer config): 
{"version":"scorer.v1","weights":{"latency_ms":0.6,"cost_usd":0.3,"region_pref":0.1}}
maya: Good. That keeps backward compatibility. We can also A/B different scorer functions for evaluation per-tenant.
ron: Telemetry/explainability: scorer should return small hints (strings) for Console UI, e.g. [{route: "r1", score:0.42, hints:["low_cost","probe_fresh"]}]. keep hint vocabulary constrained.
priya: Perf: scoring must be cheap on fast path (<200us). If too heavy, use progressive scoring: cheap pass then optional hedging pass for borderline cases. tenant-configurable.
devon: Progressive scoring design: fast proxies (p95 latency from probe, cached cost estimate) then hedging/slow pass only when score delta < threshold.
maya: Warm pools interplay: add "warmth" to telemetry_snapshot (warm_pool_size or warm_score). scorer can penalize routes with no warm pools; router may prewarm if score gain justifies cost.
ron: Also add fail-safes: if scorer crashes or times out, router falls back to legacy routing rules. metric names: scorer.latency_ms, scorer.timeout, scorer.fallback_used.
priya: Tests: integration test that runs DSL -> scorer-config -> scorer and compares outputs for seeded cases. add load test to ensure <200us at p99.
maya: Plan: 1) write RFC follow-up spec for LocalityScorer + compat API, 2) add translator in policy-compiler, 3) implement pluggable scorer in router (wasm shim), 4) telemetry/explainability contract, 5) canary rollout behind tenant feature-flag.
devon: I'll prototype the translator and a simple JS scorer shim. ron, can you sketch the telemetry schema?
ron: telemetry_snapshot minimal fields: latency_p95_ms, cost_est_usd, warm_pool_size, probe_age_ms. keep compact.
maya: I'll open the RFC follow-up PR with interface and migration checklist and tag @devon @priya @ron for review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
